description: This file implements a unit conversion web interface, including quantity definitions, unit selection, and conversion functions.

methods.name: getQuantityById
methods.description: Retrieves a quantity object by its ID from the quantities array.

methods.name: onInitPage
methods.description: Initializes the page, sets default quantity, and loads units.

methods.name: loadQuantity
methods.description: Loads a specific quantity's data into the interface, updates UI elements.

methods.name: findUnitIndexByName
methods.description: Finds the index of a unit within the current quantity by its name.

methods.name: loadUnits
methods.description: Sets the unit selection dropdowns based on stored preferences or defaults.

methods.name: localStorageGetDefault
methods.description: Retrieves a value from local storage or returns a default if not found.

methods.name: isNumber
methods.description: Checks if a value is a valid number.

methods.name: convertInternal
methods.description: Performs the conversion calculation between selected units.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Handles conversion from top input to bottom input, updates local storage.

methods.name: convertBack
methods.description: Handles conversion from bottom input to top input.
